title: Soy–Mirin Zuke Salmon Maki
description: Short-marinated raw salmon in a chilled soy-mirin sauce, rolled with scallion and sesame.

ingredients.name: Prepared, seasoned sushi rice
ingredients.note: Use the separate Sushi Rice recipe

ingredients.name: Salmon intended for raw consumption, unless cooked

steps: Simmer mirin and water gently for 2–3 minutes, then cool completely and mix with soy sauce.
Cut raw-consumption salmon into strips and marinate in the chilled soy-mirin mixture for 5–10 minutes; drain and pat dry.
Spread prepared rice on nori, position salmon and sliced scallions across the lower third and roll firmly.
Cut into eight slices and garnish with sesame seeds. Serve promptly.
notes: Marinating seasons raw salmon but does not make otherwise unsuitable raw fish safe.
Baseline makes approximately six light servings. Ingredient quantities can be scaled independently.
Prepare and season sushi rice using its separate recipe.
For uncooked salmon, use a reputable raw-consumption supplier, keep chilled and assemble promptly.
